simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בְּרוֹת (H1266) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: בְּרוֹת (bᵉrôwth) means the cypress (or some elastic tree) First listed occurrence: Song 1 17.

definitions.full: H1266. beroth [ בְּרוֺת ] noun masculine id. (Aramaic (probably North-Palestinian) form of same) only plural בְּרוֺתִים || אֲרָזִים Song 1:17 ; reference to arbour of trees as their home, compare אֶרֶז .
